mastery.levelPassSemantics: At least one server-recorded completed session for each pinned required published level version with awarded_points*100 >= max_points*80; do not average across levels.
mastery.challengePassSemantics: At least one server-evaluated correct attempt for every pinned required published challenge version, for the same account; incorrect, needs_review, skipped, draft and nonmatching versions do not count.
mastery.requiredSetSemantics: A versioned requirement set must reference the reviewed and actually published skill version, all published level versions and every published challenge for those levels; missing/draft/archived content fails eligibility.

capstone.evidenceType: authentic learner artifact plus digest and genuine independent authorized human reviewer

baselineAndEndline.reason: The new 40 baseline/endline draft questions are not integrated with a versioned examination schema; requiring them now would falsely award or lock original five skills.

eligibility.learnerName: Current account profile display name, not government-verified identity; require 2-60 characters and renderable Unicode before issue.

releaseConditions: Product owner documents explicit approval of exact 80 percent, full required challenge coverage, two attempts per session and unlimited retakes.
Legal/privacy reviewer approves disclaimer, identity limitations and public verification OFF.
Subject and accessibility reviewers approve each published course and private assessment keys separately.
Authorized capstone reviewer identity/role is server verified; freeform learner/self-approval cannot create a passed attestation.
Exact-version requirement set matches all published levels/challenges and is activated only via auditable authorized policy approval.
Exact-SHA staging Free/Premium/expired, replay, ownership, capstone, scoring and Unicode tests pass.
Separate explicit production release authorization; issuance feature flags remain disabled until then.
